description: Base Renovate preset for @unabandoned forks: keep dependencies current, soak new releases before adopting them, automerge once green, pin the supply chain, flag anything that itself becomes abandoned, and fast-track security fixes.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge Renovate PRs that bump our own first-party config repos - the unabandoned/.github reusable-workflow digest ('commit tag') pins and the unabandoned/renovate-config preset. These are internal and reviewed at source, so adopt them immediately on green with no soak.

Suppress abandonment flags only for abandoned zero-dependency leaf clones we neither ship to consumers nor plan to fork or vendor - pure dashboard noise, nothing to act on. Anything abandoned that ships in a published @unabandoned tree (e.g. ret) or that we vendor or intend to fork stays flagged (save for the reviewed frozen-leaf exception in the next rule), because that is an actionable signal we do not want to hide.

Suppress abandonment flags only for abandoned packages that declare ZERO runtime dependencies of their own and are frozen at their latest release - there is nothing under them to rot, so the flag carries no actionable signal (a direct CVE is still surfaced by the vulnerabilityAlerts above). Eligibility is strict and per-package: declaring ANY runtime dependency disqualifies a package - even if that dependency is itself current or separately suppressed here - and it must be owned (fork, vendor, or replace) rather than silenced. Being 'on latest' is not sufficient. These ship in, or are dev deps of, @unabandoned/browser-pack and @unabandoned/module-deps. (JSONStream was removed 2026-08: it declares through + jsonparse as runtime deps, so it is a fork/own target, not a silence target.)
